reviewMethod: Every actual screenshot opened with view_image; hashes rechecked.

reviewed.label: options-economy
reviewed.observation: Actual public Options menu displays Économie; the viewport resolution and architecture shadows change through this user setting, with contact-shadow meshes retained.

reviewed.label: stairs-lower
reviewed.observation: Three squad members at the lower approach; steps and contact shadows remain visible in Economy quality.

reviewed.label: stairs-middle
reviewed.observation: Leader and followers occupy different steps; the source exports separately record actual progression.

reviewed.label: stairs-upper
reviewed.observation: The leader reaches the raised landing, with followers on the approach and shadows remaining attached to their supporting surfaces.

reviewed.label: stairs-returned
reviewed.observation: The leader has descended to the lower approach. Followers remain staggered on the steps; the banter panel does not hide the route.

reviewed.label: pillar-before
reviewed.observation: The leader is hidden by the nearest opaque column while two followers stand to its left. Capture-order naming does not imply a visible initial leader.

reviewed.label: pillar-behind
reviewed.observation: The leader is visible to the right of the column; a follower remains hidden or partially clipped by its solid face.

reviewed.label: pillar-emerged
reviewed.observation: The column still masks the squad members behind it while a member remains visible at its right edge; no sprite shows through the opaque face.

reviewed.label: camera-threshold-stop
reviewed.observation: The positive x clamp has been crossed according to actual export x19.588. Architecture framing is settled; a foreground column masks part of the squad.

reviewed.label: camera-threshold-stationary
reviewed.observation: Architecture framing matches the stopped capture with the same actual player position. No oscillation is visible in this pair; native tests separately verify monotonic convergence.

reviewed.label: retreat-confirmation
reviewed.observation: Actual public retreat confirmation, with naturally charged/reserved party gauges and zero reward wording. This is not evidence of the later recovery boundary.

reviewed.label: failure
reviewed.observation: The field has returned after retreat. The screenshot does not display the required re-entry denial toast; the marker-click assumption and 45-second toast wait failed, so no boundary claim is made.

failure: The marker click did not produce the required recovery-denial toast. The 45-second wait timed out; no immediate denial, paused timer or natural recovery boundary is certified.
scope: Three public core groups pass, but this full attempt failed and does not promote QA-fuite-et-reentree. A new provenance-linked core collector excludes retreat/re-engagement claims.
limitations: Economy quality selected through public Options; no hardware cadence/FPS claim.
The failed boundary attempt is retained unchanged. No product defect or successful recovery boundary is inferred.
